requirements.title: Down/stale provider never fails the query
requirements.description: When a provider is unreachable or reports stale freshness, its ProviderResultGroup is marked degraded with a human note (e.g. "unreachable — skipped" / "last sync 3h ago") and the query still returns successfully with the remaining providers' results.

validation.notes: An unreachable provider yields a degraded group + note; the response degraded flag is set; other providers' hits are present.
Status aggregates per-provider freshness from status_endpoint reports.
